title: StoreAndForwardRecord v1 — one task's standing in the store-and-forward mailbox: the Y-007 task's id, who sent it and which sleeping node it waits for, when it was queued, its ttl in seconds and the moment that ttl runs out, its standing — held, delivered, expired, or cancelled — and the moment it was delivered (null unless delivered) — identifiers and times only, never payload content (Y-061)
